knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A tacky finish is not cured. Hold the job, check the cure and record the defect before handover.
The final records include photographs, method and product records, screening results and the sign-off.
The final inspection checks the piece against the agreed scope, the quote and the quality standard.

practicalCriteria: Inspection checklist completed in good light against the scope
Cure and residue checks recorded before handover
Care notes given and records filed before the job is closed
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% or higher. With three checks this means all three must be correct. Practical sign-off is separate: every practical criterion must be observed and met by the assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not count toward sign-off.
stopWorkCriteria: Piece handed back uncured or with residue
